# Pocketwerk

> Pocketwerk is a free, open-source macOS app released under the MIT license by DigitalIQ. It groups apps, files, folders and links into "pockets" that can each get their own icon in the macOS Dock.

Clicking a pocket's Dock icon opens a themed popup directly above that icon; a second click closes it. Pocketwerk runs on macOS 26 Tahoe and later, on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Its interface is available in English and German.

Pocketwerk has no account, no tracking and no analytics. Its data stays in a JSON file on the Mac. It goes online only for a daily update check and to fetch favicons for links.

## Features

- Pockets: apps, files, folders and links in one group with its own Dock icon. Popup views: grid, list and tiles, with pages and an adaptive layout.
- Keyboard: arrow keys and Return, Space for Quick Look, type to search, ⌘1 to ⌘9 to jump between pockets; mouse wheel and trackpad swipes move between pockets.
- Group actions: Open All, Hide All and Quit All per pocket; ⌥-click quits an app; ⌘-click selects several items to open together.
- Folders open inside the popup; drag and drop works in and out.
- Design Studio: Liquid Glass, colors, gradients, photos, the blurred desktop picture, textures and animated backgrounds that react to the pointer; borders, fonts, corner radius; dozens of built-in themes and presets; own themes can be saved.
- Dock icon styles: mini grid of the contained apps, fanned stack, folder shape, SF Symbol icon packs, emoji, text or an own image.
- Dock profiles: save the whole macOS Dock as a profile and switch with a hotkey, the menu bar, the command line or a URL; optionally quit or launch apps when switching; custom spacers.
- Global hotkeys per pocket and per profile without the macOS Accessibility permission. Menu bar mode. Launch at login.
- Smart pockets: Most Used, Recently Opened, Running Apps.
- Coming in version 1.1: an on-device assistant (Apple Intelligence, on supported Macs with macOS 26) that edits a pocket from plain language, with undo.

## Install

1. Download the DMG from https://github.com/DigitalIQ/pocketwerk/releases/latest or run `brew install --cask digitaliq/tap/pocketwerk`.
2. Pocketwerk is not notarized, so macOS blocks the first launch.
3. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security and click "Open Anyway" once.
